name: Atlas AS7-D — silhouette study
notes: NEW silhouette-only manual cross-section sculpture. No inherited coarse geometry, no detail pass, no 100k voxel budget. References listed in docs/graphics/component-shape-study.md Shape review 2: shortened and seated skull, removed fake giant chest ports, reduced missile/gun projections; thinner frontal thigh. Reference iteration 3: original stock AS7-D broad faceted torso hoods, recessed skull between shoulders, angular shoulder taper; 10-vertex individually drawn hull sections instead of rounded octagonal templates. Reference iteration 4: explicitly planar shoulder caps, elliptical-but-angular combat gauntlets, knee shields, tapered greaves and wide toed armored boots; right arm mirrors left. Fifth pass: broad chest avoids sharp waist taper; new separate pelvic cuirass and center codpiece connect torso and thigh roots. Pass 6: separate hollow right torso autocannon muzzle shroud rather than tiny projecting rod. Pass 7: a separate skull jaw and palms with close-in knuckles replace unarticulated mitten-shaped fists. Shape pass 9: larger flat-topped skull with pronounced brow, cheeks and angular jaw; rising tapered shoulder shells; athletic scale relative to Jenner and Wolverine. References AS7-D tabletop render and AS7-D fan CAD sculpture. Pass 10: visibly framed five-tube torso launcher; long beveled front kneecaps with a separate structural silhouette rather than amorphous circles. Pass 11: separate trapezoidal hip-and-upper-thigh shields with flat frontal slabs and a raised angular crest, matched to unpainted Atlas mini rather than adding generic leg bulk. Pass 12: physically narrow Atlas thigh shield plates to stop them swallowing the pelvis; restore a visible upper-arm-to-gauntlet neck. Pass 13: vertically separate reference-accurate hip and upper torso: stretch the individually authored leg shapes to 32 grid units while translating the unmodified upper components 5 units, preventing stubby limb-to-torso appearance. Pass 14: front/back photographs of stock AS7-D and three-quarter CAD confirm flat upper shoulder cowls, integrated skull channel and distinct short shoulder guards. Replaced oversized rounded major armor blocks with straight-edged hand-drawn x/y profiles. Pass 15: corrected oversized pill-like upper arms using reference full-torso/side Atlas photos, and rebuilt the stock Death's Head's brow and eye sockets as separate structures. Pass 16: stock AS7-D torso-mounted AC20 was too flush with chest. Extended its rectangular open shroud forward as an independent assembly, without adding panel detail. Pass 18: match AS7-D skull reference's flaring cheekbone/chin contour with independent left/right cheek structures. Scale Atlas up 11% to make 100t heavy silhouette visibly taller than Wolverine while retaining the authored shapes. Pass 19: compare Syllogy Atlas left/right from straight-on resin view: planar eight-corner upper arm guards, broader separated shoulder roofs, visible narrow elbow frames. Preserve a distinguishable sculpted jaw and left rack. Pass 20: reference Atlas right-torso AC20 as a genuinely projecting large rectangular hollow shroud, distinguished from Wolverine's arm cannon. Dark bore backing recessed behind a 7x7 muzzle aperture; still hand-sculpted without subdivision. Pass 21: after inspecting the actual Godot render, reduced the over-projecting AC20 to a compact 5x6 torso-mounted hollow housing, lowered below the skull/shoulders, retaining a visible recess rather than a chest-crossing bar.
